core_findings_evidence_shape.name: core_findings_evidence_shape
core_findings_evidence_shape.value:
("core_findings"."evidence_kind" is null and "core_findings"."evidence_path" is null and "core_findings"."evidence_value" is null)
        or ("core_findings"."evidence_kind" = 'file' and "core_findings"."evidence_path" is not null)
        or ("core_findings"."evidence_kind" <> 'file' and "core_findings"."evidence_value" is not null)

core_recordings_tracks.name: core_recordings_tracks
core_recordings_tracks.value:
("core_recordings"."source" = 'call' and "core_recordings"."studio_track_path" is not null)
        or ("core_recordings"."source" = 'upload' and "core_recordings"."studio_track_path" is null)

proposal_options_retainer_shape.name: proposal_options_retainer_shape
proposal_options_retainer_shape.value:
("proposal_options"."retainer_monthly" is null and "proposal_options"."retainer_months" is null)
        or ("proposal_options"."retainer_monthly" > 0 and "proposal_options"."retainer_months" between 1 and 36)

tasks_project_needs_client.name: tasks_project_needs_client
tasks_project_needs_client.value: "tasks"."project_id" is null or "tasks"."client_id" is not null

proof_versions_ready_has_type.name: proof_versions_ready_has_type
proof_versions_ready_has_type.value: "proof_versions"."status" <> 'ready' or ("proof_versions"."kind" is not null and "proof_versions"."mime_type" is not null)

library_files_ready_has_type.name: library_files_ready_has_type
library_files_ready_has_type.value: "library_files"."status" <> 'ready' or ("library_files"."kind" is not null and "library_files"."mime_type" is not null and "library_files"."size_bytes" is not null)

project_document_versions_content.name: project_document_versions_content
project_document_versions_content.value:
("project_document_versions"."kind" in ('figma', 'link') and "project_document_versions"."url" is not null and "project_document_versions"."storage_path" is null)
        or ("project_document_versions"."kind" in ('pdf', 'file') and "project_document_versions"."storage_path" is not null and "project_document_versions"."url" is null)
